parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is a faucet switch made of stainless steel, typically cylindrical with a textured grip for turning.
parts.Functional_description: It controls the flow of water by rotating to open or close the valve mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axis to adjust water flow.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is another faucet switch made of stainless steel, similar to the first one, used for controlling temperature or flow.
parts.Functional_description: It regulates either hot or cold water flow depending on the plumbing configuration.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates to adjust the water temperature or flow rate.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body or frame of the faucet, made of brass for corrosion resistance and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the internal water channels and connects the switches and spout.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides structural support for the faucet assembly.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: This is the spout of the faucet, made of stainless steel, curved to direct water flow into the sink.
parts.Functional_description: It delivers water from the internal plumbing to the sink basin.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel horizontally to direct water flow to different areas of the sink.
